params.name: settlementDate
params.description: The settlement date for the filter.

params.name: settlementPeriod
params.description: The settlement period for the filter. This should be an integer from 1-50 inclusive.

params.name: bmUnit
params.description: The BM Units to query. Elexon or NGC BMU IDs can be used. If omitted, results for all BM units will be returned.

params.name: format
params.description: Response data format. Use json/xml to include metadata.

items.docs:
This endpoint provides the physical data for multiple requested BMUs or all BMUs.
It returns the data valid for a single settlement period.
            
Only one dataset can be queried at a time: PN, QPN, MILS, or MELS.
The results from each dataset are transformed to a common response model, with fields not present in all 4 datasets dropped.
            
The settlement period to query must be specified as a date and settlement period. The date must be given in the format yyyy-MM-dd.
